source.title: Combining Organic and Foliar Fertilization to Enhance Soil Fertility and Mitigate Physiological Disorders of Durian (Durio zibethinus Murr.) Fruit in the Tropics
source.citation: Dang LV, Quyen NK, Ngoc NP, Ly LM, Thao PTP, Hung NN. Plants. 2025;14(8):1185.
source.provenance_note: Compiled manually from the published article. No model-generated values are treated as source evidence.

design.blocking: Randomized complete block design conducted separately in each of three durian orchards; four treatments; three replicates per treatment; 12 durian trees per treatment.
design.notes: The paper states the randomized complete block design and replication structure but does not explicitly identify the physical randomization unit.

population.notes: Selected orchards were approximately 0.4-0.5 ha with 110-140 trees. Trees used for the experiment had similar trunk and stem diameters. Pest and weed control were applied uniformly.

provenance.locator: Section 4.1 Study Location, Soil, Plants, and Climate

interventions.name: Common background NPK fertilization
interventions.dose_text: 0.45 kg N, 0.45 kg P, and 0.45 kg K per tree
interventions.timing_text: 30% at 25 days after fruit set; 40% at 50 days after fruit set; 30% at 35 days before fruit harvest
interventions.notes: Applied uniformly to all treatment arms; therefore it is background management rather than the experimental contrast.

provenance.locator: Section 4.3 Experimental Design

interventions.name: Organic manure
interventions.product_name: Commercial organic fertilizer from PPE Co., Ltd.
interventions.composition_text: Sugarcane filter cake was the primary feedstock. The paper reports total C 15.4%, porosity 76.2%, exchangeable K 15.0 cmolc kg^-1, exchangeable Ca 61.6 cmolc kg^-1, and available P 3.6 g kg^-1, with nutrient composition attributed to a previous study.
interventions.frequency_text: One application per season as described
interventions.notes: Commercial organic manure produced in Can Tho City, Vietnam.

provenance.locator: Sections 4.2 and 4.3

interventions.name: Foliar fertilization
interventions.composition_text: Authors report, according to the producer, 4% K2O and 4.3% Ca.
interventions.notes: The article describes timing and product composition but does not state the applied spray dose/concentration in Sections 4.2-4.3.

provenance.locator: Sections 4.2 and 4.3
